meta.description:
50 Cent Action delivers an adrenaline-fueled lineup of high-octane movies and series, curated by award winning rapper, actor and producer, Curtis “50 Cent Jackson. Experience intense action thrillers that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Shows: Kill Bill: Volume 1, Kill Bill: Volume 2, Jackie Brown, Erased, Line of Duty
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus, Plex
